svg.title: CPU used and CPU requested
svg.desc: CPU used against CPU requested for each setup in 20 minutes of repeated peaks, cycles and the sudden jump. HPA+ request demand requested more CPU just before each peak; the CPU forecast kept extra CPU for longer after each peak; the reactive formula's pods used all of their requested CPU during every peak.
svg.text: The same 20-minute windows as the traffic figure. The line is the CPU requested by running pods, 1 CPU each; the
shaded area is the CPU they used. Where the area reaches the line, the pods were full and requests had to wait.
CPU used, shaded in each setup's colour
stays up longer after each peak
